en_us.research.TaintSeed.stage.1:
Occasionally tight knots of Tainted tendrils will form. From out of this 'seed' foul tainted air will spew which acts as the basis for new Taint growth.
These seeds can lash out to defend themselves, but the risk must be taken if you wish to rid an area of taint.
Without the foul air these seeds create, tainted growth soon withers and dies.
en_us.research.FIRSTSTEPS.stage.1:
Who would have thought that a few sprinkles of dust could have created this marvellous book? It is mostly blank, but it hints at a powerful new form of magic: Thaumaturgy.
Firstly I will need to study the magical world that has been shown to me. For that I will need a tool - a Thaumometer the book calls it.
A normal crafting table won't do however since the magical energies I need to channel while crafting it are quite delicate. A sprinkling of Salis Mundus on a mundane crafting table should solve that. The book has taught me the proper incantation to use so it should be a simple matter.
To keep myself on track I will make a list of all the requirements that need to be met on the first page of each new entry.
en_us.golem.head.text.scout: The basic clockwork head enhanced with improved biothaumic eyes.
en_us.research.ADVANCEDTURRET.stage.1: My recent discovery of advanced artificial minds might allow me to make some much needed improvements to my automated turrets.
en_us.thaumcraft.research_ui.requirements_serv: Raw source requirements. Only the server validates and pays them; this is not a completion check.
en_us.research.ARCANEBORE.stage.1:
I need to work out an automated way of digging out large areas. It should be a fairly simple matter to redesign one of my new turrets to target the ground instead of enemies.
My discovery of the breaker focus effect should allow me to create a specialized and limited version of a caster that can be used by this mining turret.
en_us.card.beacon.text: You believe that the beacon interacts in some way with the mystical aura. You carefully study this and while you cannot find anything concrete this time you have been inspired. You regain 2 inspiration, 1 bonus draw and an additional category will gain the full bonus upon completion.
en_us.research.UNLOCKARTIFICE.stage.2:
I have penned my own designs based on the little information I could find and my own experimental findings. Time to put theory into practice.
Not only will the goggles reveal hidden things, but they will also reduce the vis cost of certain thaumaturgical tasks.
Lastly these goggles will allow me to see the vis or essentia content of objects in the world which will prove a great boon I am sure.The most important thing I have learned however is the possibility of crafting delicate mechanical devices using magic and imbuing them with arcane power.
en_us.research.FOCUSEXCHANGE.stage.2:
My theory has proven correct! By applying this pattern to a focus I can use it to select a type of block in the world. I simply need to sneak while right-clicking on it.
When I then cast the effect on most other blocks it will exchange the target block for the one I selected earlier. Obviously I must be carrying enough of the selected blocks for the exchange to happen and the targeted block (or what it normally drops when broken) will appear in my inventory.
It seems I cannot exchange particularly complex blocks, or those that cannot be broken by normal means.
Apart from the cost to cast it, it seems the vis cost is also subtracted for each block exchanged in this way. I should be cautious.
en_us.research.BASICTURRET.stage.1: A few attacks from wandering monsters has recently turned my mind towards home defense. I should design some sort of automated device that will defend my home from unwanted intruders.
en_us.got.dream: You awaken from a strange dream. You quickly write it down before the memory fades.
en_us.card.dragonegg.text: The aura around the egg swirls with strange and chaotic energies. Occasionally you glimpse strange order in the chaos.
en_us.research.VISAMULET.stage.1: If I wish to recharge my vis storage items I currently need to return to the nearest recharge pedestal or carry one of them around. This is not always convenient however - I must find a portable way to recharge my items.
en_us.card.revelation.text: Studying the Eldritch is a dangerous pursuit, but the knowledge you can uncover is often worth it. You gain 30 Eldritch progress and 5 to 10 progress in a random category. You will also gain some temporary and normal Warp and an additional category will gain the full bonus upon completion.
en_us.research.ESSENTIASMELTER.stage.3:
I have managed to break down all my samples of primary and secondary essentia into a liquid state. The process has been slow and tedious however. Until I simplify the process it will never be practical for large scale usage.
Luckily extracting essentia from objects has a lot in common with the smelting of metals. Using a furnace as a base I might be able to create an essentia smeltery that automatically melts down items and separates out individual types of essentia.
en_us.research.Firebat.stage.1:
Fire bats, or Hellbats, are usually found in the Nether. Engulfed in flame and unreasonably aggressive they are perfectly suited to the environment they live in. They also have the alarming tendency to explode when attacking.
One wonders what possible evolutionary advantage exploding gives them as a species, but the same can be asked of creepers.
en_us.research.ESSENTIASMELTERTHAUMIUM.stage.1:
The basic essentia smelter is quite crude, if I have to be honest with myself. It is extremely inefficient and rather slow. I chalk this up to the low quality of the materials it is crafted from.
I believe Thaumium could prove useful in improving the smelting process. I should run some experiments to see how effective it would be at containing essentia slurry.
I should probably also improve the plumbing inside the smelter itself.
en_us.golem.arm.text.fine: These arms end in delicate and dexterous hands.
en_us.research.EldritchCrab.stage.1:
Eldritch Crabs, or Helmed Crabs, are a most unusual and unnatural creature. I am convinced these creatures are the result of magical tinkering.
A pair of powerful claws make them dangerous to face in combat, but it is how they use those claws that make them horrific. They leap at their foes heads in an attempt to decapitate them. If successful they are somehow able to burrow into the victims body and take control of what remains. Their abdomen looks much like a helmed head allowing them to disguise the true nature of the husk they now control.
These husks are not much more powerful than a normal zombie so the reason why they do this eludes me - they are much more of a threat without their 'mount'. Possibly they were created as weapons of terror by some demented inventor?
en_us.research.BrainyZombie.stage.1:
I have observed that some zombies seem much more aware than their lumbering brethren. Their eyes burn with a malevolent intelligence leading me to believe that they retained much more intelligence after death than is normal. They are definitely more aggressive and dangerous than a normal zombie.
They should make good sources of brain matter for my experiments.
en_us.research.f_VOIDSEED.text: Examine something native to the Void
en_us.golem.head.text.smart_scout: Using both biothaumic eyes and brain, this head is the pinnacle of the biothaumic art.
en_us.thaumcraft.EARTH.text: Hurls a blast of earthen shrapnel that causes significant damage and may break weaker blocks.
en_us.research.FOCUSFLUX.stage.1: Using the elements as a weapon has its benefits, but raw magic can be just as destructive - most creatures are harmed if exposed to raw, unfiltered vis. Even armor cannot protect you from this energy.
en_us.research.BELLOWS.stage.2:
The Arcane Bellows performs much the same function as its mundane counterpart, the only difference is that it happily pumps away by itself sending forth a stream of never-ending air.
As I had hoped they can be attached to furnances to increase their smelting speed.
It is also possible to attach them to crucibles to reduce the time it takes for their water to boil.
Bellows can be deactivated by applying a redstone signal.
I am confident more uses will reveal themselves eventually.
en_us.research.BOTTLETAINT.stage.1:
I should be able to replicate the Taint causing properties of flux. I am not exactly sure why I would want to, but sometimes progress requires risk.
The process should be fairly simple - I merely need to create a concentrated mixture of flux and it should easily react with almost anything to create Taint.
en_us.research.ThaumSlime.stage.1:
These purple slimes are a strange offshoot of their green cousins. Normal slimes form from the organic gunk that occasionally collects in caves, but Thaumic Slimes are formed from the purple proto-matter residue left over from magical mishaps.
Apart from their strange origins they are rather similar to their green cousins for the most part. They do appear to have the ability to split at will, often spitting a lesser version of themselves at targets that venture too close. If there are no targets nearby, split slimes will endeavour to reform to once again form a larger organism.
en_us.research.LEVITATOR.stage.1:
I have always been fascinated by the power of flight. I am sure flying is almost within my grasp, but first I need to learn the fundamentals.
I need to study simple levitation first.
en_us.thaumcraft.research_table.theory_deferre: Writing tools and paper can be stored here. Theorycrafting is not yet ported.
en_us.research.INFUSION.stage.2: Unsurprisingly, infusion crafting is proving to be a lot more complex than I expected. Simply trying to infuse aspects into something does not work. I will need a relatively complex system to stabilize the entire process. I have drawn up plans for a Runic Matrix that will allow me to do this.
en_us.card.enchantment.text: You study normal enchantment to see how it functions at a fundamental level. You are sure that is shares a lot in common with the enchantment methods used in Infusion and Artifice. You lose 5 experience levels, but will gain 15 to 20 progress in both Infusion and Auromancy.

en_us.research.HUNGRYCHEST.stage.2: This chest, which I have decided to call a Hungry Chest, will gobble up any loose items that touches it. In effect it functions like a hopper, though it does not output any items it gathers to other inventories.
en_us.research.FOCUSSPLIT.stage.2:
I have managed to draw up designs for two new focus modifiers. The first splits a single target result into two, allowing me to have two different effects apply to the target.
The second modifier does the same, except it splits trajectories.
The only downside is that the split reduces to power of any effects placed below them, though I mitigate the full impact somewhat.
Much to my suprise I have discovered that these modifiers can be split recursivly allowing for some interesting focal designs.
en_us.research.DIOPTRA.stage.1: While a thaumometer will show me the local aura it would be useful to be able to get a general overview of the aura in a larger area. A device like this should be simple enough to design and make.
en_us.research.THEORYRESEARCH.stage.1:
For me to make any progress as a thaumaturge I cannot rely on simply studying the world around me or stumbling upon ancient knowledge. I will need to make my own discoveries and expand my knowledge through experimentation. Crafting my own theories is the only way.
I will need to create a comfortable workspace to do my research with ample supplies like writing materials and paper. I should craft some scribing tools and place it upon a table.
en_us.thaumcraft.research_ui.icon_deferred: This research icon is not yet ported.
en_us.card.scripting.text: A large part of Golemancy is creating intricate arcane texts to control your creations. By creating some test scripts you can further your understanding. Gain 25 Golemancy. This consumes additional paper and ink from the research table.
en_us.card.awareness.text: You open yourself to the flows of vis around you. You gain a deeper understanding of how it works and the underlying nature of things, but this leaves you metaphysically vulnerable. Gain 20 Auromancy. There is a chance you gain Eldritch knowledge and Warp.
en_us.research.EldritchGuardian.stage.1:
These ghost-like figures are a dangerous menace. They can be found wherever the walls of reality are at their thinnest. I believe they act as guardians of such places, protecting those weak spots from trespassers.
Their form is held together by dimensional energies from some other place making them much weaker in our world. I would hate having to confront them in whatever place they call home.
Their touch is deadly and they are able to hurl entropic dimensional energy at those too far to reach.
en_us.research.VERDANTCHARMS.stage.1: I occasionally find myself being affected with poisons and other nasty afflictions. I should find a way to protect myself.
en_us.card.mindmatter.text: You carefully examine and take apart some basic components in the hopes of finding new ways to assemble them into more complex creations. Gain %1$s Artifice.

en_us.research.UNLOCKAUROMANCY.stage.2:
Slowly but surely I am beginning to understand the nature of Vis. So much is still hidden to me, but I think I now know enough to begin moulding it to my will. For this I will need a tool. A very special tool.
I have stumbled upon some dusty scrolls penned by a long dead thaumaturge. It describes how to craft wands that are used to store and channel vis. The insights I learned from the scrolls were useful, but the application seems so limiting. Why trap vis in a wand when it is all around you? Even the wand itself seems impractical to me. If you need something to grasp and shape the aura it should be something appropriate. Something like a glove.
Any old glove will not do - it will need to be handcrafted from the finest leather and laced with vis conductive materials. Iron is a poor vis conductor, but it is all I have available to me at this time.
Luckily there will be no mucking about with magical woods and so forth to store the vis, but I will need some way of channeling vis directly from the aura - a vis resonator if you will. I will also attach a stripped-down thaumometer to the glove so I can monitor the local aura.
Lastly I will place a receptacle on the back of the glove. The scrolls mentioned using special crystalline foci to channel the vis from the wands. Their crystalline lattice shapes the vis into different configurations to create all manner of useful effects. Brilliant actually. It irks me that I did not think of it first. Fortunately I have already thought of several ways to improve on the design and the shape of the glove lends itself on manipulating the flow of vis much more than the old style wands could.
en_us.research.FOCUSBREAK.stage.1:
Calling up the destructive power of perditio I should be able to design a pattern that can be used to safely break most blocks.
I should also study examples of the Fortune and Silk Touch enchantments. Digging magic will be much more useful if I can duplicate their effects.
en_us.research.UNLOCKINFUSION.stage.2:
My experiments have been successful. I have been able to infuse simple objects with essentia, but the process is complex, difficult and dangerous. I need to find a way to simplify it before I can truly delve into all the possibilities it holds.The experiments did have some practical results as well.
I have also discovered a fabric that is soft, supple and easy to enchant. I have designed patterns for a set of clothing made from this fabric.
It will not only be comfortable and stylish, but while worn it will reduce the vis cost of certain types of thaumaturgical tasks. The clothing should also be easily dyeable much like leather armor.
All in all I am quite pleased with what I have done here.

en_us.warp.text.9: You suddenly feel reluctant to break things.
en_us.golem.trait.text.ranged: The golem can attack targets at range.
en_us.research.FOCUSRIFT.stage.2:
I have managed to create a focus that manipulates dimensional magic. Most inanimate objects will be shifted into this other realm temporarily like some sort of portable hole.
The diameter of this hole will remain fixed at around 3 yards, but I should be able to manipulate the depth quite a bit.
en_us.thaumcraft.research_ui.parents_missing: The prerequisites are not yet met.
en_us.research.SEALBREAK.stage.ADV:
I can now craft an advanced version of the seal that will allow you to filter more items at once and allow the golem to break blocks as if they are using Silk Touch.
Golems will take longer to break block if Silk Touch is used.
en_us.research.BASEAUROMANCY.stage.1:
I have the casting glove, but now I need to craft the foci. The old scrolls aren't very clear on how to go about this, so I will need to find my own way.
I have played with the idea of assembling a focus from crystals and then using vis to bind them together. My initial experiments have been failures... explosive failures.
I think the answer I seek lies with an alchemical process.
Using an ordo crystal as a core I might be able to leverage its ordered structure to grow a focus around it. While this is happening it should absorb praecantatio and auram essentia.
The result should hopefully be a crystal focus able to absorb and manipulate vis.

en_us.research.ESSENTIATRANSPORT.stage.1:
During the infusion crafting process essentia is drawn directly from jars and floats through the air to the infusion matrix. The magic of the matrix keeps it stable enough for the infusion process, but normally the essentia is changed in such a way that it becomes unusable for anything else.
If only I can find a way to draw essentia through the air outside of the infusion process and still keep it stable.
en_us.golem.arm.text.breakers: These arms end in a pair of pneumatic, diamond tipped grinders.

en_us.research.INFERNALFURNACE.stage.1:
I have found that a large part of my day tends to be taken up with smelting things in a furnace. Surely there is a way I can make this less of a chore?
Time to go somewhere hot for inspiration. Somewhere really hot.

zh_tw.card.enchantment.text: 你研究一般的附魔來理解其基本原理。你確信其附魔原理與注魔以及匠法皆息息相關。 你消耗5經驗等級，但在注魔與靈氣術獲得15~20進度。
zh_tw.research.FOCUSSCATTER.stage.2:
我成功將一個核心媒介的軌跡拆分為複數，但成果卻未達我的期望。這其中有兩個問題：
首先，雖然我能控制主要軌跡分岔的數量，但卻無法控制分裂後的軌跡。他們會單純地往隨機方向分散。還好我已經想到該如何限制分散的錐狀範圍。
第二個問題是，我創造愈多分岔，每個分岔的效果就愈虛弱。其實這並不意外——我所引導的魔素有限。我可以額外汲取更多魔素來稍微舒緩這種現象，但每個分岔依然會比原本還弱。
這項修改在每個核心中僅能使用一次。
zh_tw.research.BASEAUROMANCY.stage.2:
利用煉金術來製作核心確實可行。核心既穩定又乾淨——現在我只需要嵌入適當的紋章。為此，我需要核心操作台。
我擬定了一張核心操作台的藍圖。其作用機制各方面都與奧術工作台雷同，但魔素並非用於合成物品，而是用來將紋章嵌入核心。
要印上核心的紋章也必須經過設計。我希望能用一種紋章來放出火焰，但是我還需要多做些研究。
zh_tw.research.FOCUSFLUX.stage.1: 使用元素作為武器有其優點，而單純的魔力也是具有殺傷力的——暴露於原始、未特化的魔素中對大多數生物都是有害的。身上的裝甲也無法擋下這股能量。
zh_tw.got.dream: 你從一個奇怪的夢中醒來。你急忙在忘卻之前將它記錄下來。
zh_tw.research.FOCUSBREAK.stage.1:
我設計了一種紋章，能透過驅使 perditio 的破壞能量來安全擊破大多數方塊。
我也該研究一些幸運與絲綢之觸的附魔樣本。若能重現這些效果，挖掘魔法會更加實用。
zh_tw.research.ARCANEBORE.stage.1:
我需要一個能夠大範圍自動挖掘的手段。我應該能輕鬆地將我的新砲台改造成瞄準地面而非敵人。
在核心破壞效果中的發現應該能讓我製作出專用的特製施術裝置，用於這座挖掘用的砲台。
zh_tw.research.VERDANTCHARMS.stage.1: 我偶爾會發現自己受到毒或是其他煩人的異常狀態影響。我應該要設法保護自己。
zh_tw.research.ESSENTIASMELTER.bellows: 把風箱安置在熔煉爐旁可以大幅提高其溫度，加快物品被分解的速度。
zh_tw.golem.arm.text.breakers: 這雙手腕改造成氣動的鑽刃切削器。
zh_tw.research.ESSENTIASMELTER.stage.2:
這項實驗前景光明，但有些難以預料。幸運的是火勢及時撲滅，頭髮幾天後應該就長回來了。
看來利用特殊的煉金手法將物件融解會是我的首選。不幸的是一直以來我都只用原初結晶進行測試。我也該找出次級源質——由兩種原初要素組成的源質結晶進行試驗。
當然也有被稱為三級源質的第三階源質。這是由原初與次級要素，或是兩種次級要素混合而成。

de_de.research.MINDBIOTHAUMIC.stage.1:
As predicted the clockwork minds I have created offers very little in the way of abstract reasoning and autonomy. Attempting to create more complex clockworks has met with very little success, so I turning to something I already know will work - living brains.
By studying them I might be able to unlock the secret behind true intelligence and autonomy.

I am confident more uses will reveal themselves eventually.
de_de.card.enchantment.text: You study normal enchantment to see how it functions at a fundamental level. You are sure that is shares a lot in common with the enchantment methods used in Infusion and Artifice. You lose 5 experience levels, but will gain 10 to 15 progress in both Infusion and Auromancy.
de_de.research.VERDANTCHARMS.stage.1: I occasionally find myself being affected with poisons and other nasty afflictions. I should find a way to protect myself.
de_de.card.scripting.text: A large part of Golemancy is creating intricate arcane texts to control your creations. By creating some test scripts you can further your understanding. Gain 20 Golemancy. This consumes additional paper and ink from the research table.
de_de.research.ESSENTIATRANSPORT.stage.1:
During the infusion crafting process essentia is drawn directly from jars and floats through the air to the infusion matrix. The magic of the matrix keeps it stable enough for the infusion process, but normally the essentia is changed in such a way that it becomes unusable for anything else.
If only I can find a way to draw essentia through the air outside of the infusion process and still keep it stable.
de_de.research.ThaumSlime.stage.1:
These purple slimes are a strange offshoot of their green cousins. Normal slimes form from the organic gunk that occasionally collects in caves, but Thaumic Slimes are formed from the purple proto-matter residue left over from magical mishaps.
Apart from their strange origins they are rather similar to their green cousins for the most part. They do appear to have the ability to split at will, often spitting a lesser version of themselves at targets that venture too close. If there are no targets nearby, split slimes will endeavour to reform to once again form a larger organism.
de_de.research.BASEAUROMANCY.stage.1:
I have the casting glove, but now I need to craft the foci. The old scrolls aren't very clear on how to go about this, so I will need to find my own way.
I have played with the idea of assembling a focus from crystals and then using vis to bind them together. My initial experiments have been failures... explosive failures.
I think the answer I seek lies with an alchemical process.
Using an ordo crystal as a core I might be able to leverage its ordered structure to grow a focus around it. While this is happening it should absorb praecantatio and auram essentia.
The result should hopefully be a crystal focus able to absorb and manipulate vis.
de_de.research.BOTTLETAINT.stage.1:
I should be able to replicate the Taint causing properties of flux. I am not exactly sure why I would want to, but sometimes progress requires risk.
The process should be fairly simple - I merely need to create a concentrated mixture of flux and it should easily react with almost anything to create Taint.
de_de.research.FOCUSMAGIC.stage.1: Using the elements as a weapon has its benefits, but raw magic can be just as destructive - most creatures are harmed if exposed to raw, unfiltered vis. Even armor cannot protect you from this energy.
de_de.research.FOCUSCURSE.stage.2:
As I suspected the pech wand is thaumaturgical in nature. Unfortunately this discovery leaves me with more questions than answers.
At least I was able to decipher the wands magic into a usable focus pattern. The Curse pattern magically cripples and poisons anything it hits. It even curses the target with a streak of bad luck. Quite nasty and probably devastating if combined with other effects.
de_de.research.INFERNALFURNACE.stage.1:
I have found that a large part of my day tends to be taken up with smelting things in a furnace. Surely there is a way I can make this less of a chore?
Time to go somewhere hot for inspiration. Somewhere really hot.
de_de.research.NIMBUSRING.stage.2: I have made plans for a bauble I am calling the Nimbus Ring. It makes the wearer lighter greatly reducing falling damage. Additionally it can create a momentary puff of air below the wearer when they jump, allowing them to perform a second jump in mid-air.
de_de.research.ESSENTIASMELTERTHAUMIUM.stage.1:
The basic essentia smelter is quite crude if I have to be honest with myself. It is extremely inefficient and rather slow. I chalk this up to the low quality of the materials it is crafted from.
I believe Thaumium could prove useful in improving the smelting process. I should run some experiments to see how it effective it would be at containing essentia slurry.
I should probably also improve the plumbing inside the smelter itself.
de_de.research.DIOPTRA.stage.1: While a thaumometer will show me the local aura it would be useful to be able to get a general overview of the aura in a larger area. A device like this should be simple enough to design and make.
de_de.research.VISAMULET.stage.1: If I wish to recharge my vis storage items I currently need to return to the nearest recharge pedestal or carry one of them around. This is not always convenient however - I must find a portable way to recharge my items.
de_de.research.EldritchCrab.stage.1:
Eldritch Crabs or Helmed Crabs are a most unusual and unnatural creature. I am convinced these creatures are the result of magical tinkering.
A pair of powerful claws make them dangerous to face in combat, but it is how they use those claws that make them horrific. They leap at their foes heads in an attempt to decapitate them. If successful they are somehow able to burrow into the victims body and take control of what remains. Their abdomen looks much like a helmed head allowing them to disguise the true nature of the husk they now control.
These husks are not much more powerful than a normal zombie so the reason why they do this eludes me - they are much more of a threat without their 'mount'. Possibly they were created as weapons of terror by some demented inventor?
de_de.research.BASICTURRET.stage.1: A few attacks from wandering monsters has recently turned my mind towards home defense. I should design some sort of automated device that will defend my home from unwanted intruders.
de_de.research.Firebat.stage.1:
Fire bats, or Hellbats are usually found in the Nether. Engulfed in flame and unreasonably aggressive they are perfectly suited to the environment they live in. They also have the alarming tendency to explode when attacking.
One wonders what possible evolutionary advantage exploding gives them as a species, but the same can be asked of creepers.
de_de.card.beacon.text: You believe that the beacon interacts in some way with the mystical aura. You carefully study this and while you cannot find anything concrete this time you have been inspired. You regain 2 inspiration and gain 1 bonus draw.
de_de.research.ESSENTIASMELTER.stage.2:
My experiments are promising if a bit unpredictable. Fortunately the fires where easily quenched and my hair should grow back in a few days.
It seems melting objects down in a special alchemical process is my best option. Unfortunately my tests so far has been on primal crystals. I should also test my finding on crystals containing secondary essentia - that is essentia made up of a combination of two primal aspects.
A third tier known as tertiary essentia also exists. That is essentia made up of a mixture of primal and secondary aspects, or two secondary aspects.
de_de.research.ARCANEBORE.stage.1:
I need to work out an automated way of digging out large areas. It should be a fairly simple matter to redesign one of my new turrets to target the ground instead of enemies.
My discovery of the breaker focus effect should allow me to create a specialized and limited version of a caster that can be used by this mining turret.
de_de.golem.trait.text.light: Der Golem ist leichter als der Durchschnitt, was seine Geschwindigkeit und Agilität erhöht. Wird durch "Schweres Gehäuse" aufgehoben und hebt jenes auf.
de_de.book.start.1:
"Letzte Nacht hatte ich einen sehr merkwürdigen Traum.

IIm Traum nahm ich drei dieser merkwürdigen Kristalle. Ich habe sie zusammen mit etwas Redstone in einer Schüssel mit einem Feuerstein zermahlen."
de_de.golem.trait.text.deft: Dieser Golem hat hohe Geschicklichkeit und kann Aufgaben vollbringen, die Präzision und Feingefühl erfordern. Wird durch "Ungeschickt" aufgehoben und hebt jenes auf.
de_de.research.ADVANCEDTURRET.stage.1: My recent discovery of advanced artificial minds might allow me to make some much needed improvements to my automated turrets.
de_de.research.THEORYRESEARCH.stage.1:
For me to make any progress as a thaumaturge I cannot rely on simply studying the world around me or stumbling upon ancient knowledge. I will need to make my own discoveries and expand my knowledge through experimentation. Crafting my own theories is the only way.
I will need to create a comfortable workspace to do my research with ample supplies like writing materials and paper. I should craft a some scribing tools and place it upon a table.
de_de.research.FOCUSBREAK.stage.2:
There is a enchantment that allows you to break blocks without actually breaking them - instead they retain their unbroken form.
By studying this 'Silk Touch' Enchantment I might be able to replicate this as a focus pattern.
de_de.false.start: Es fühlt sich an als sollte es funktionieren, aber etwas fehlt...
de_de.research.BASEINFUSION.stage.1:
I am now ready to begin crafting enchanted objects and tools.I have drawn up designs for some banners to decorate my lab. I can apply a phial of essentia to them to have them display that essentia symbol.I have also discovered a fabric that is soft, supple and easy to enchant. I have designed patterns for a set of clothing made from this fabric.
It will not only be comfortable and stylish, but while worn it will reduce the vis cost of certain types of thaumaturgical tasks. The clothing should also be easily dyeable much like leather armor.
All in all I am quite pleased with what I have done here.
de_de.card.mindmatter.text: You carefully examine and take apart some basic components in the hopes of finding new ways to assemble them into more complex creations. Gain %1$s Artifice.
de_de.research.SEALCOLLECT.stage.ADV:
I can now craft an advanced version of the seal that will allow you to filter more items at once and give you greater control over how the items are filtered, though golems need to be much smarter to perform tasks created by this seal.
You can choose to have the seal ignore NBT or damage values when filtering items, use the ore dictionary, or to have it filter items from the same mod as those in the filter.
de_de.research.BrainyZombie.stage.1:
I have observed that some zombies seem much more aware than their lumbering brethren. Their eyes burn with a malevolent intelligence leading me to believe that they retained much more intelligence after death than is normal. They are definitely more aggressive and dangerous than a normal zombie.
They should make good sources of brain matter for my experiments.
de_de.golem.trait.text.fragile: Der Golem besteht aus empfindlichen Komponenten oder schwachen Materialien, was seine Lebenskraft und seinen Schutz verringert. Wird durch "Gepanzert" aufgehoben und hebt jenes auf.
de_de.research.FOCUSEXCHANGE.stage.2:
My theory has proven correct! By applying this pattern to a focus I can use it to select a type of block in the world. I simply need to sneak while right-clicking on it.
When I then cast the effect on most other blocks it will exchange the target block for the one I selected earlier. Obviously I must be carrying enough of the selected blocks for the exchange to happen and the targeted block (or what it normally drops when broken) will appear in my inventory.
It seems I cannot exchange particularly complex blocks, or those that cannot be broken by normal means.
Apart from the cost to cast it, it seems the vis cost is also subtracted for each block exchanged in this way. I should be cautious.
de_de.research.ESSENTIASMELTER.stage.3:
I have managed to break down all my samples of primary and secondary essentia into a liquid state. The process has been slow and tedious however. Until I simplify the process it will never be practical for large scale usage.
Luckily extracting essentia from objects has a lot in common with the smelting of metals. Using a furnace as a base I might be able to create an essentia smeltery that automatically melts down items and separates out individual types of essentia.
de_de.card.awareness.text: You open yourself to the flows of vis around you. You gain a deeper understanding of how it works and the underlying nature of things, but this leaves you metaphysically vulnerable. Gain 15 Auromancy. There is a chance you gain Eldritch knowledge and Warp.
de_de.card.dragonegg.text: The aura around the egg swirls with strange and chaotic energies. Occasionally you glimpse strange order in the chaos.
de_de.research.INFUSION.stage.2: Unsurprisingly, infusion crafting is proving to be a lot more complex than I expected. Simply trying to infuse aspects into something does not work. I will need a relatively complex system to stabilize the entire process. I have drawn up plans for a Runic Matrix that will allow me to do this.
de_de.research.FOCUSFROST.stage.1:
It should be a simple matter for me to use the fundamentals I have learned to harness other elements.
Fire may be destructive, but intense cold can be nearly as harmful with the added benefit of chilling my enemies and slowing them down to a crawl.
de_de.research.TaintSeed.stage.1:
Occasionally tight knots of Tainted tendrils will form. From out of this 'seed' foul tainted air will spew which acts as the basis for new Taint growth.
These seeds can lash out to defend themselves, but the risk must be taken if you wish to rid an area of taint.
Without the foul air these seeds create, tainted growth soon withers and dies.

ko_kr.book.start.1:
"어젯밤에 이상한 꿈을 꿨다.

꿈에서 나는 내가 찾았던 3개의 이상한 결정을 가져다가 부싯돌을 사용해 한 줌의 레드스톤과 함께 그릇에 빻았다."
ko_kr.card.revelation.text: 엘드리치를 공부하는 것은 위험한 일이지만, 그곳에서 발견할 수 있는 지식은 종종 그만한 가치가 있습니다. §l이계의 지식§r 이론 30포인트를 얻고, 무작위 항목에서 5~10포인트를 얻습니다. 일반 워프 및 일시적인 워프를 얻게 되며, 추가 카테고리는 완료 시 완전한 보너스를 받습니다.
ko_kr.item.runed_tablet.text: 더 거대한 무언가의 일부인 듯 합니다.
ko_kr.research.SEALCOLLECT.title: 행동의 인장: 수집
ko_kr.card.beacon.text: 이 신호기는 오라와 어떻게든 상호작용하는 것으로 보입니다. 영감을 받은 구체적인 것도 찾을 수 없는 와중 이것을 천천히 공부합니다. 영감 2개를 얻고 추가 페이지를 얻으며, 추가 카테고리는 완료 시 완전한 보너스를 받습니다.
ko_kr.warp.text.9: 갑자기 뭔가 부수는 행동을 하기 힘들어졌습니다.
ko_kr.card.synergy.text: 골렘학의 근본에는 연금술, 마공학, 인퓨전이 포함되어 있습니다. 이 세 분야가 어떻게 상호작용하는지 완전히 이해함으로써 골렘학을 숙달할 수 있을 것입니다. §l연금술§r과 §l마공학§r과 §l인퓨전§r 이론에서 20포인트를 나눠 잃고, §l골렘학§r 이론 30포인트를 얻으며, 추가 카테고리는 완료 시 완전한 보너스를 받습니다.
ko_kr.card.enchantment.text: 레벨이 어떻게 작동하는지 보기 위해 마법부여를 연구합니다. 마법부여는 인퓨전 및 마도학과 상당한 공통점이 있다고 생각합니다. 5레벨을 잃고, §l인퓨전§r과 §l마도학§r 이론 15~20포인트를 얻습니다.

ru_ru.thaumcraft.golem.invalid_properties: У этого голема повреждены данные компонентов.
ru_ru.gui.thaumcraft.focus.name: Название фокуса
ru_ru.gui.thaumcraft.focus.rejected: Не удалось создать: проверьте исследования, XP, кристаллы и сложность.
ru_ru.gui.thaumcraft.focus.incomplete: Заполните все ветви и уменьшите сложность схемы.
ru_ru.thaumcraft.research_ui.image_deferred: Иллюстрация этой страницы ещё не перенесена.
ru_ru.research.UNLOCKAUROMANCY.stage.2:
Медленно, но верно я начинаю понимать природу энергии Вис. Так много всего ещё сокрыто от меня, но думаю, что теперь я знаю достаточно, для того чтобы начать менять её форму по своему желанию. Для этого мне понадобится инструмент. Особый инструмент.
Я наткнулся на несколько пыльных свитков, написанных давно умершим тауматургом. В них описывается, как создавать жезлы, которые нужны для того, чтобы хранить и направлять Вис. Знания, что я подчерпнул из свитков, были полезны, но их применение кажется очень ограниченным. Зачем пленять Вис внутри жезла, когда он есть повсюду? Даже сам жезл кажется мне непрактичным. Если Вам нужно что-то хватать или формировать ауру, то для этого должно быть что-то подходящее. Что-то вроде перчатки.
Какая-нибудь старая перчатка сделать этого не сможет, она должна быть изготовлена из кожи наивысшего качества, а также покрыта материалами, проводящими Вис. Железо - достаточно плохой проводник, но это всё, что доступно мне на данном этапе.
К счастью, мне не придётся слоняться по магическим лесам и заниматься прочими вещами, для того чтобы хранить Вис, но мне понадобится какой-то способ по выкачиванию его прямо из ауры - Вис-резонатор, если угодно. Я также прикреплю к перчатке простенький таумометр, чтобы следить за местной аурой.
Ну и наконец, я сделаю углубление на задней части перчатки. В свитках упоминается использование специальных кристаллических линз для направления потока Вис, хранящегося в жезлах. Их кристаллическая решётка изменяет форму Вис, позволяя создавать всевозможные полезные эффекты. Это гениально. Раздражает то, что я не подумал об этом в первую очередь. К счастью, я уже придумал несколько способов по улучшению дизайна и формы перчатки, что позволит управлять потоком Вис в большей степени, чем это могли делать старые жезлы.
ru_ru.research.FIRSTSTEPS.stage.1:
Кто бы мог подумать, что небольшая горсть пыли сможет создать эту чудесную книгу? Она по большей части пуста, но уже намекает на новую мощную форму магии: Тауматургию.
Для начала нужно изучить тот магический мир, что был показан мне. И для этого понадобится особый инструмент - Таумометр, так он зовётся в книге.
На обычном верстаке невозможно сделать подобные предметы, поскольку магические силы, которые я должен направлять во время их создания, требуют осторожного обращения. Но, если посыпать обычный верстак пылью Salis Mundus, это решит проблему. Книга научила меня подходящему заклинанию, поэтому это не должно составить особого труда.
Чтобы отслеживать свой прогресс, я буду записывать список всех требований, которые необходимо выполнить на первой странице каждой новой записи.
ru_ru.thaumcraft.research_ui.requirement_unava: Этот элемент пока недоступен в порте.
ru_ru.card.enchantment.text: Вы изучаете обычное зачарование, чтобы понять, как оно работает на фундаментальном уровне. Вы уверены, что оно имеет много общего с методами зачарования, используемыми в Изобретениях или Наполнении. Вы теряете 5 уровней опыта, но получаете от 15 до 20 очков прогресса в Ауромантии и Наполнении.
ru_ru.card.scripting.text: Большая часть работы в Големостроении состоит в написании сложных магических текстов для контроля ваших созданий. Создав несколько пробных текстов, Вы сможете лучше понять её. Вы получаете 25 очков прогресса в Големостроении. На это будут израсходованы дополнительные листы бумаги и чернила со стола исследований.
ru_ru.research.INFUSIONSTABLE.stage.1:
Процесс наполнения оказался намного более неустойчивым, чем я ожидал. Хоть всякие оккультные аттрибуты и уменьшают этот эффект, но не настолько, как описано в древних текстах. Кажется, что размещение более, чем 12 таких предметов, скорее мешает, чем помогает процессу.
Мне нужно отыскать более эффективный способ для увеличения стабильности. Как ни странно, мне кажется, что с этим мне сможет помочь технология, не связанная с магией.
Всем известно, что мирские источники энергии, вроде красного камня, только мешают тауматургии. Естественно, бросать красный камень в область дестабилизированного наполнения далеко не самый лучший вариант, однако, вполне возможно, что есть способ использовать создаваемые им помехи в своих целях.
ru_ru.research.UNLOCKINFUSION.stage.2:
Мои эксперименты оказались успешными. Я смог наполнить простые предметы эссенцией, но процесс этот был трудным и опасным. Мне нужно найти способ по его упрощению, прежде чем я действительно смогу вникнуть во всё то, на что он способен.В процессе экспериментов мне удалось достичь нескольких конкретных результатов.
Я смог открыть ткань, мягкую, эластичную и легко поддающуюся зачарованию. Я спроектировал несколько моделей для комплекта одежды, сделанного из этой ткани.
Он будет не просто удобным и стильным, но ещё и снизит затраты Вис на некоторые тауматургические задачи во время ношения. Одежда должна также легко красится, как кожаная броня.
В целом, я доволен тем, что сделал.
ru_ru.warp.text.9: У Вас внезапно появляется непреодолимое желание крушить всё вокруг.
ru_ru.thaumcraft.research_ui.links_deferred: Слишком большие связи исследований безопасно пропущены.
ru_ru.research.FLUXRIFT.stage.1:
Как я и подозревал, эти разломы - дыры в самой реальности. Хаотичные энергии, которые вытекают из них, невероятно опасны и мне нужно найти способ, как можно закрыть разломы, и чем быстрее, тем лучше.
Как бы там ни было, мои наблюдения за разломом стали причиной обнаружения некоторых интересных деталей. Похоже, что они подпитываются Выбросами - чем больше присутствует их в окружении, тем больше разрастаются разломы. С течением времени они также становятся более нестабильными и, в конечном итоге, эта неустойчивость взрывается потоком чистой хаотической энергии. Эта энергия может принимать различные формы и редко несёт в себе что-то хорошее. К счастью, после подобного происшествия они снова стабилизируются. Последствия взрыва потока чистой хаотической энергии зависят от размера раскола.
Несмотря на то, что мне пока неизвестно, как их закрыть, я наверняка смогу найти способ сохранять их в стабильном состоянии.
ru_ru.card.beacon.text: Вы думаете, что маяк каким-то образом взаимодействует с магической аурой. Вы внимательно изучаете его, и хотя в этот раз у Вас и не получается прийти к чему-то конкретному, Вы чувствуете себя воодушевлённым. Вы восстанавливаете 2 очка вдохновения и берёте дополнительную карту, а также дополнительная категория получит полный бонус по завершении исследования.
ru_ru.book.start.1:
"Вчера ночью мне приснился самый странный сон на свете.

Во сне я взял три из тех странных кристаллов, которые находил ранее, и, добавив горстку редстоуна, измельчил их в миске при помощи кремня."
ru_ru.research.BASEAUROMANCY.stage.2:
Использование алхимии для создания линзы действительно было путём, ведущим к успеху. Она крепка, прозрачна, теперь мне лишь осталось вставить в неё подходящую схему-шаблон. Для этого мне понадобится Конфигуратор линз.
Я уже набросал несколько его чертежей. Принцип его работы очень схож с тем, по которому действует магический верстак, но вместо того, чтобы использовать Вис для изготовления предметов, он будет отпечатывать шаблоны прямо на кристалле линзы.
Мне придётся также разрабатывать те шаблоны, которые нужно будет отпечатать на кристалле. Можно составить такой шаблон, который будет порождать пламя, но для этого мне нужно сделать ещё несколько исследований.
ru_ru.thaumcraft.research_ui.map_empty: В этой категории нет видимых исследований.
ru_ru.thaumcraft.research_ui.icon_deferred: Эта иконка исследования ещё не перенесена.
ru_ru.research.GRAPPLEGUN.stage.1:
В своих дальнейших стремлениях я сумел понять один важный факт: Мобильность - ключ ко всему.
Мне нужно разработать некий инструмент, позволяющий без каких либо трудностей пересекать сложную местность.
Я считаю, что с этим мне помогут справиться магниты. Редкоземельные элементы хоть и можно использовать для создания магнитов, однако с ними существует одна проблема - у них слишком ограниченное количество материалов, к которым они намагничиваются. Поэтому, если я смогу усилить их врождённые магические свойства с помощью некой формой магии внушения, я смогу заставить их прилипать к любой поверхности.
ru_ru.card.mindmatter.text: Вы тщательно осматриваете и разбираете несколько базовых компонентов в надежде найти новые пути, позволяющие собрать из них более сложные творения. Вы получаете %1$s очков прогресса в Изобретениях.
ru_ru.research.MIRROR.stage.1:
Мой таумономикон делает мне некоторые любопытные намёки на то, что зеркала имеют множество мистических применений. Одно из таковых - это возможность связывать разные физические места между собой посредством этих самых зеркал и использовать магию внушения.
Больше никаких подсказок книга мне не даёт - как всегда, придётся самого во всём разбираться.
ru_ru.research.BrainyZombie.stage.1:
Я заметил, что некоторые зомби ведут себя гораздо более осмысленно, чем их шумные собратья. В их глазах пылает разумная злоба, и это заставляет меня поверить в то, что после смерти они сохранили гораздо больше интеллекта, чем должны были. Они, определённо, более агрессивны и опасны, чем обычные зомби.
Они послужат отличным источником мозгов в моих экспериментах.
ru_ru.thaumcraft.research_ui.markup_deferred: Часть исходной разметки страницы пока не поддерживается.
ru_ru.thaumcraft.research_table.theory_deferre: Здесь можно хранить писчие инструменты и бумагу. Теорикрафт ещё не перенесён.
ru_ru.thaumcraft.research_ui.content_unavailab: Содержимое этой страницы пока невозможно отобразить.
ru_ru.thaumcraft.research_ui.requirements_serv: Исходные требования. Только сервер проверяет и оплачивает их; это не отметка о выполнении.
ru_ru.golem.leg.text.roller: Единичное колесо. Способно развивать большую скорость, однако оснащённый им голем не может прыгать и подниматься по крутым склонам.
ru_ru.thaumcraft.research_ui.recipe_content_un: Содержимое этого исходного рецепта пока недоступно.
ru_ru.thaumcraft.theorycraft.other_owner: За этим столом уже работает другой исследователь.
ru_ru.thaumcraft.jei.transfer.missing: Не хватает ингредиентов или кристаллов вис
ru_ru.thaumcraft.jei.transfer.space: Недостаточно места в инвентаре для предметов с верстака
ru_ru.thaumcraft.jei.enchantment_cost_note: Затраты учитывают уже имеющиеся инфузионные зачарования показанного предмета.
ru_ru.thaumcraft.jei.enchantment_warp_note: Имеющиеся инфузионные зачарования могут добавить варп при создании предмета.

zh_cn.research.EldritchCrab.stage.1:
邪术爪牙和爪牙头目是最不寻常和不自然的生物。我敢肯定这些生物是邪恶的魔法造物。
一对强大的爪子使它们在面对交战时变得非常危险，但是要知道他们如何使用这对爪子会让人觉得更可怕。 它们凶猛扑向敌人并企图斩杀掉敌人的头颅。 如果成功了，它们会侵入被害者的身体并控制剩下的驱壳。 它们的腹部看起来像一个戴着头盔的头，使它们在驱壳中伪装的更真实。
这些驱壳跟普通的僵尸相比并不太强，所以这也是为何它们会逃避我——他们没有驱壳伪装的时候会更有威胁。可能它们是被疯狂的发明家创造出来作为恐怖分子的武器？
zh_cn.card.beacon.text: 你相信信标能够以某种方式影响周围神秘的灵气。你仔细地进行研究，虽然没有取得十足的进展，但也从中受到了启发。你获得了2点灵感与一次额外的抽卡机会，并且将会有多个额外的分支在完成时获得全额奖励。
zh_cn.research.THEORYRESEARCH.stage.1:
对于我这样的神秘使，仅仅通过研究周围的世界或是偶然发现古老的知识是无法取得进展的。我需要有自己的发现，并通过实验来提高我的知识水平。只有构造属于我自己的理论才是唯一的方法。
我需要一个的舒适的工作空间来进行研究，并且准备好充足的书写工具和纸张。我先应该制作一个笔与魔放到桌子上。
zh_cn.research.Firebat.stage.1:
九狱焱蝠常常出现在下界。周身被火焰包裹的他们常表现出与他们居住环境相符的残暴进攻性。警告-他们在进攻时有强烈的自爆倾向。
人们纳闷的是这种自爆倾向给他们带来了怎样的进化优势？当然，对于爬行者我们也有相同的疑问。
zh_cn.research.ESSENTIASMELTERTHAUMIUM.stage.1:
说实话，这个基本的源质冶炼厂是相当粗糙的。它非常低效和缓慢。我将这一点归咎于它的制作材料过于简陋。
我相信神秘金属可以对改进源质冶炼厂有用。我应该进行一些实验，看看它如何有效地留住源质黏浆。
冶炼厂内部的管道也可以进行一些改进。

nl_nl.research.TaintSeed.stage.1:
Occasionally tight knots of Tainted tendrils will form. From out of this 'seed' foul tainted air will spew which acts as the basis for new Taint growth.
These seeds can lash out to defend themselves, but the risk must be taken if you wish to rid an area of taint.
Without the foul air these seeds create, tainted growth soon withers and dies.
nl_nl.research.FIRSTSTEPS.stage.1:
Who would have thought that a few sprinkles of dust could have created this marvellous book? It is mostly blank, but it hints at a powerful new form of magic: Thaumaturgy.
Firstly I will need to study the magical world that has been shown to me. For that I will need a tool - a Thaumometer the book calls it.
A normal crafting table won't do however since the magical energies I need to channel while crafting it are quite delicate. A sprinkling of Salis Mundus on a mundane crafting table should solve that. The book has taught me the proper incantation to use so it should be a simple matter.
To keep myself on track I will make a list of all the requirements that need to be met on the first page of each new entry.
nl_nl.golem.head.text.scout: The basic clockwork head enhanced with improved biothaumic eyes.
nl_nl.research.ADVANCEDTURRET.stage.1: My recent discovery of advanced artificial minds might allow me to make some much needed improvements to my automated turrets.
nl_nl.thaumcraft.FIRE.text: Hurls flame at your target and sets it alight.
nl_nl.research.ARCANEBORE.stage.1:
I need to work out an automated way of digging out large areas. It should be a fairly simple matter to redesign one of my new turrets to target the ground instead of enemies.
My discovery of the breaker focus effect should allow me to create a specialized and limited version of a caster that can be used by this mining turret.
nl_nl.card.beacon.text: You believe that the beacon interacts in some way with the mystical aura. You carefully study this and while you cannot find anything concrete this time you have been inspired. You regain 2 inspiration, 1 bonus draw and n additional category will gain the full bonus upon completion..
nl_nl.research.UNLOCKARTIFICE.stage.2:
I have penned my own designs based on the little information I could find and my own experimental findings. Time to put theory into practice.
Not only will the goggles reveal hidden things, but they will also reduce the vis cost of certain thaumaturgical tasks.
Lastly these goggles will allow me to see the vis or essentia content of objects in the world which will prove a great boon I am sure.The most important thing I have learned however is the possibility of crafting delicate mechanical devices using magic and imbuing them with arcane power.
nl_nl.research.FOCUSEXCHANGE.stage.2:
My theory has proven correct! By applying this pattern to a focus I can use it to select a type of block in the world. I simply need to sneak while right-clicking on it.
When I then cast the effect on most other blocks it will exchange the target block for the one I selected earlier. Obviously I must be carrying enough of the selected blocks for the exchange to happen and the targeted block (or what it normally drops when broken) will appear in my inventory.
It seems I cannot exchange particularly complex blocks, or those that cannot be broken by normal means.
Apart from the cost to cast it, it seems the vis cost is also subtracted for each block exchanged in this way. I should be cautious.
nl_nl.research.BASICTURRET.stage.1: A few attacks from wandering monsters has recently turned my mind towards home defense. I should design some sort of automated device that will defend my home from unwanted intruders.
nl_nl.got.dream: You awaken from a strange dream. You quickly write it down before the memory fades.
nl_nl.card.dragonegg.text: The aura around the egg swirls with strange and chaotic energies. Occasionally you glimpse strange order in the chaos.
nl_nl.research.VISAMULET.stage.1: If I wish to recharge my vis storage items I currently need to return to the nearest recharge pedestal or carry one of them around. This is not always convenient however - I must find a portable way to recharge my items.
nl_nl.card.revelation.text: Studying the Eldritch is a dangerous pursuit, but the knowledge you can uncover is often worth it. You gain 30 Eldritch progress and 5 to 10 progress in a random category. You will also gain some temporary and normal Warp and an additional category will gain the full bonus upon completion.
nl_nl.research.ESSENTIASMELTER.stage.3:
I have managed to break down all my samples of primary and secondary essentia into a liquid state. The process has been slow and tedious however. Until I simplify the process it will never be practical for large scale usage.
Luckily extracting essentia from objects has a lot in common with the smelting of metals. Using a furnace as a base I might be able to create an essentia smeltery that automatically melts down items and separates out individual types of essentia.
nl_nl.research.Firebat.stage.1:
Fire bats, or Hellbats are usually found in the Nether. Engulfed in flame and unreasonably aggressive they are perfectly suited to the environment they live in. They also have the alarming tendency to explode when attacking.
One wonders what possible evolutionary advantage exploding gives them as a species, but the same can be asked of creepers.
nl_nl.research.SEALCOLLECT.stage.ADV:
I can now craft an advanced version of the seal that will allow you to filter more items at once and give you greater control over how the items are filtered, though golems need to be much smarter to perform tasks created by this seal.
You can choose to have the seal ignore NBT or damage values when filtering items, use the ore dictionary, or to have it filter items from the same mod as those in the filter.
nl_nl.research.ESSENTIASMELTERTHAUMIUM.stage.1:
The basic essentia smelter is quite crude if I have to be honest with myself. It is extremely inefficient and rather slow. I chalk this up to the low quality of the materials it is crafted from.
I believe Thaumium could prove useful in improving the smelting process. I should run some experiments to see how it effective it would be at containing essentia slurry.
I should probably also improve the plumbing inside the smelter itself.
nl_nl.golem.arm.text.fine: These arms end in delicate and dexterous hands.
nl_nl.research.BrainyZombie.stage.1:
I have observed that some zombies seem much more aware than their lumbering brethren. Their eyes burn with a malevolent intelligence leading me to believe that they retained much more intelligence after death than is normal. They are definitely more aggressive and dangerous than a normal zombie.
They should make good sources of brain matter for my experiments.
nl_nl.research.ESSENTIASMELTER.stage.2:
My experiments are promising if a bit unpredictable. Fortunately the fires were easily quenched and my hair should grow back in a few days.
It seems melting objects down in a special alchemical process is my best option. Unfortunately my tests so far have been on primal crystals. I should also test my finding on crystals containing secondary essentia - that is essentia made up of a combination of two primal aspects.
A third tier known as tertiary essentia also exists. That is essentia made up of a mixture of primal and secondary aspects, or two secondary aspects.
nl_nl.golem.head.text.smart_scout: Using both biothaumic eyes and brain, this head is the pinnacle of the biothaumic art.
nl_nl.thaumcraft.EARTH.text: Hurls a blast of earthen shrapnel that causes significant damage and may break weaker blocks.
nl_nl.research.BELLOWS.stage.2:
The Arcane Bellows performs much the same function as its mundane counterpart, the only difference is that it happily pumps away by itself sending forth a stream of never-ending air.
As I had hoped they can be attached to furnances to increase their smelting speed.
It is also possible to attach them to crucibles to reduce the time it takes for their water to boil.
Bellows can be deactivated by applying a redstone signal.
I am confident more uses will reveal themselves eventually.
nl_nl.research.CLOUDRING.stage.2: I have made plans for a bauble I am calling the Cloudstepper Ring. It makes the wearer lighter greatly reducing falling damage. Additionally it can create a momentary puff of air below the wearer when they jump, allowing them to perform a second jump in mid-air.
nl_nl.research.FOCUSCURSE.stage.2:
As I suspected the pech wand is thaumaturgical in nature. Unfortunately this discovery leaves me with more questions than answers.
At least I was able to decipher the wands magic into a usable focus pattern. The Curse pattern magically poisons and cripples anything it hits with random maladies. It can even curse the target with a streak of bad luck. Quite nasty and probably devastating if combined with other effects.
Even if it misses the curse will leave a lasting mark on the world in the form of a corrupting field of energy. The field will eventually fade.
nl_nl.research.VISBATTERY.stage.2:
I have succeeded in creating a vis battery.
If the local aura is above 95% of its normal capacity the battery will absorb vis and if the aura drops below 75% it will discharge.
There are a few drawbacks however. While it is quicker and a lot more reliable than natural vis crystals, the battery still takes some time to react to changes in the local aura. The second drawback is it's capacity. It can only store 10 points of vis. My attemps to increase this has proven disasterous. I guess this just means that I will need to use them in larger numbers.
Applying a redstone signal to the battery will not only prevent it from functioning, but it will rapidly discharge any vis it is holding back into the aura.
nl_nl.research.BOTTLETAINT.stage.1:
I should be able to replicate the Taint causing properties of flux. I am not exactly sure why I would want to, but sometimes progress requires risk.
The process should be fairly simple - I merely need to create a concentrated mixture of flux and it should easily react with almost anything to create Taint.
nl_nl.research.ThaumSlime.stage.1:
These purple slimes are a strange offshoot of their green cousins. Normal slimes form from the organic gunk that occasionally collects in caves, but Thaumic Slimes are formed from the purple proto-matter residue left over from magical mishaps.
Apart from their strange origins they are rather similar to their green cousins for the most part. They do appear to have the ability to split at will, often spitting a lesser version of themselves at targets that venture too close. If there are no targets nearby, split slimes will endeavour to reform to once again form a larger organism.
nl_nl.research.LEVITATOR.stage.1:
I have always been fascinated by the power of flight. I am sure flying is almost within my grasp, but first I need to learn the fundamentals.
I need to study simple levitation first.
nl_nl.research.INFUSION.stage.2: Unsurprisingly, infusion crafting is proving to be a lot more complex than I expected. Simply trying to infuse aspects into something does not work. I will need a relatively complex system to stabilize the entire process. I have drawn up plans for a Runic Matrix that will allow me to do this.
nl_nl.card.enchantment.text: You study normal enchantment to see how it functions at a fundamental level. You are sure that is shares a lot in common with the enchantment methods used in Infusion and Artifice. You lose 5 experience levels, but will gain 15 to 20 progress in both Infusion and Auromancy.
nl_nl.research.HUNGRYCHEST.stage.2: This chest, which I have decided to call a Hungry Chest, will gobble up any loose items that touches it. In effect it functions like a hopper, though it does not output any items it gathers to other inventories.
nl_nl.research.FOCUSSPLIT.stage.2:
I have managed to draw up designs for two new focus modifiers. The first splits a single target result into two, allowing me to have two different effects apply to the target.
The second modifier does the same, except it splits trajectories.
The only downside is that the split reduces to power of any effects placed below them, though I mitigate the full impact somewhat.
Much to my suprise I have discovered that these modifiers can be split recursivly allowing for some interesting focal designs.
nl_nl.research.DIOPTRA.stage.1: While a thaumometer will show me the local aura it would be useful to be able to get a general overview of the aura in a larger area. A device like this should be simple enough to design and make.
nl_nl.research.THEORYRESEARCH.stage.1:
For me to make any progress as a thaumaturge I cannot rely on simply studying the world around me or stumbling upon ancient knowledge. I will need to make my own discoveries and expand my knowledge through experimentation. Crafting my own theories is the only way.
I will need to create a comfortable workspace to do my research with ample supplies like writing materials and paper. I should craft a some scribing tools and place it upon a table.
nl_nl.card.scripting.text: A large part of Golemancy is creating intricate arcane texts to control your creations. By creating some test scripts you can further your understanding. Gain 25 Golemancy. This consumes additional paper and ink from the research table.
nl_nl.card.awareness.text: You open yourself to the flows of vis around you. You gain a deeper understanding of how it works and the underlying nature of things, but this leaves you metaphysically vulnerable. Gain 20 Auromancy. There is a chance you gain Eldritch knowledge and Warp.
nl_nl.research.EldritchGuardian.stage.1:
These ghost-like figures are a dangerous menace. They can be found wherever the walls of reality are at their thinnest. I believe they act as guardians of such places, protecting those weak spots from trespassers.
Their form is held together by dimensional energies from some other place making them much weaker in our world. I would hate having to confront them in whatever place they call home.
Their touch is deadly and they are able to hurl entropic dimensional energy at those too far to reach.
nl_nl.research.VERDANTCHARMS.stage.1: I occasionally find myself being affected with poisons and other nasty afflictions. I should find a way to protect myself.
nl_nl.card.mindmatter.text: You carefully examine and take apart some basic components in the hopes of finding new ways to assemble them into more complex creations. Gain %1$s Artifice.
nl_nl.research.UNLOCKAUROMANCY.stage.2:
Slowly but surely I am beginning to understand the nature of Vis. So much is still hidden to me, but I think I now know enough to begin moulding it to my will. For this I will need a tool. A very special tool.
I have stumbled upon some dusty scrolls penned by a long dead thaumaturge. It describes how to craft wands that are used to store and channel vis. The insights I learned from the scrolls were useful, but the application seems so limiting. Why trap vis in a wand when it is all around you? Even the wand itself seems impractical to me. If you need something to grasp and shape the aura it should be something appropriate. Something like a glove.
Any old glove will not do - it will need to be handcrafted from the finest leather and laced with vis conductive materials. Iron is a poor vis conductor, but it is all I have available to me at this time.
Luckily there will be no mucking about with magical woods and so forth to store the vis, but I will need some way of channeling vis directly from the aura - a vis resonator if you will. I will also attach a stripped-down thaumometer to the glove so I can monitor the local aura.
Lastly I will place a receptacle on the back of the glove. The scrolls mentioned using special crystalline foci to channel the vis from the wands. Their crystalline lattice shapes the vis into different configurations to create all manner of useful effects. Brilliant actually. It irks me that I did not think of it first. Fortunately I have already thought of several ways to improve on the design and the shape of the glove lends itself on manipulating the flow of vis much more than the old style wands could.
nl_nl.research.FOCUSBREAK.stage.1:
Calling up the destructive power of perditio I should be able to design a pattern that can be used to safely break most blocks.
I should also study examples of the Fortune and Silk Touch enchantments. Digging magic will be much more useful if I can duplicate their effects.
nl_nl.research.UNLOCKINFUSION.stage.2:
My experiments have been successful. I have been able to infuse simple objects with essentia, but the process is complex, difficult and dangerous. I need to find a way to simplify it before I can truly delve into all the possibilities it holds.The experiments did have some practical results as well.
I have also discovered a fabric that is soft, supple and easy to enchant. I have designed patterns for a set of clothing made from this fabric.
It will not only be comfortable and stylish, but while worn it will reduce the vis cost of certain types of thaumaturgical tasks. The clothing should also be easily dyeable much like leather armor.
All in all I am quite pleased with what I have done here.
nl_nl.book.start.1:
"I had the strangest dream last night.

In the dream I took three of those strange crystals I've been finding and ground them with a handful of redstone in a bowl using a piece of flint."
nl_nl.golem.trait.text.ranged: The golem can attack targets at range.
nl_nl.research.FOCUSRIFT.stage.2:
I have managed to create a focus that manipulates dimensional magic. Most inanimate objects will be shifted into this other realm temporarily like some sort of portable hole.
The diameter of this hole will remain fixed at around 3 yards, but I should be able to manipulate the depth quite a bit.
nl_nl.research.FOCUSFLUX.stage.1: Using the elements as a weapon has its benefits, but raw magic can be just as destructive - most creatures are harmed if exposed to raw, unfiltered vis. Even armor cannot protect you from this energy.
nl_nl.research.BASEAUROMANCY.stage.1:
I have the casting glove, but now I need to craft the foci. The old scrolls aren't very clear on how to go about this, so I will need to find my own way.
I have played with the idea of assembling a focus from crystals and then using vis to bind them together. My initial experiments have been failures... explosive failures.
I think the answer I seek lies with an alchemical process.
Using an ordo crystal as a core I might be able to leverage its ordered structure to grow a focus around it. While this is happening it should absorb praecantatio and auram essentia.
The result should hopefully be a crystal focus able to absorb and manipulate vis.
nl_nl.research.ESSENTIATRANSPORT.stage.1:
During the infusion crafting process essentia is drawn directly from jars and floats through the air to the infusion matrix. The magic of the matrix keeps it stable enough for the infusion process, but normally the essentia is changed in such a way that it becomes unusable for anything else.
If only I can find a way to draw essentia through the air outside of the infusion process and still keep it stable.
nl_nl.golem.arm.text.breakers: These arms end in a pair of pneumatic, diamond tipped grinders.
nl_nl.research.SEALCOLLECT.title: Control Seal: Collect
nl_nl.golem.head.text.smart: This head contains an advanced biothaumic brain, giving the golem greater capabilities and the ability to learn.
nl_nl.research.EldritchCrab.stage.1:
Eldritch Crabs or Helmed Crabs are a most unusual and unnatural creature. I am convinced these creatures are the result of magical tinkering.
A pair of powerful claws make them dangerous to face in combat, but it is how they use those claws that make them horrific. They leap at their foes heads in an attempt to decapitate them. If successful they are somehow able to burrow into the victims body and take control of what remains. Their abdomen looks much like a helmed head allowing them to disguise the true nature of the husk they now control.
These husks are not much more powerful than a normal zombie so the reason why they do this eludes me - they are much more of a threat without their 'mount'. Possibly they were created as weapons of terror by some demented inventor?
nl_nl.research.INFERNALFURNACE.stage.1:
I have found that a large part of my day tends to be taken up with smelting things in a furnace. Surely there is a way I can make this less of a chore?
Time to go somewhere hot for inspiration. Somewhere really hot.
nl_nl.research.MINDBIOTHAUMIC.stage.1:
